title: Increment-chain execution
statement: Let $C,d,K$ be natural numbers, let $\ell_i$ be a label for each natural number $i$, and let $r$ be one of the five registers. Suppose that for every $i<K$, the instruction at $\ell_i$ increments register $r$ and proceeds to $\ell_{i+1}$. For any initial register assignment and input position, for every $i\le K$, starting at $\ell_0$ reaches $\ell_i$ with register $r$ increased by $i$, all other registers unchanged, and the same input position, appending no output, in at most $i$ steps, uniformly for every output string already printed.
